title: SrcGen4J
description: Configures the srcgen4j code generation: the package pattern, the DSL-constraint to bean-validation mappings, and, per DSL model type, the artifact factories to run and where their output goes. A model's hint is merged on top of the built-in 'srcgen4j-default.json' preset, so it may be partial.

constraintMappings.description: Mappings of DSL constraints to Java validation annotations.

name.description: Fully qualified DSL model type name, e.g. 'org.fuin.dsl.cqrs.cqrsDsl.ValueObject'.

artifactFactory.description: Fully qualified artifact factory class name.

folder.description: Target folder the output is written to.

module.description: Optional module override for this artifact.

group.description: Optional group override for this artifact.
